name: living-type-01
title: NULLWORX / Living Type 01
author: Nullworx
description: An installable procedural wordmark: editable type, three Paper Shaders art directions, validated recipes, accessible text and a static WebGL fallback. EXPERIMENTAL / OWNER_REVIEW.

files.content:
# NULLWORX / LIVING TYPE 01 **EXPERIMENTAL · OWNER_REVIEW · not published · no npm package · no public registry admission.** One installable animated wordmark. Editable text, three art-directed Paper Shaders treatments, validated recipes, accessible DOM text, and a static fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable. The type is the mask. The Material renders inside the letterforms — it is not a gradient panel placed behind a heading. ## What is installed The shadcn item `living-type-01` writes this folder to `components/living-type-01/`: | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `living-type.tsx` | The client component and its public props. | | `living-type.module.css` | Scoped styling, presets, fallback, error and focus states. | | `living-type-font.css` | Embedded Unbounded ASCII subset (WOFF2 data URI) and its `@font-face`. | | `living-type-recipe.ts` | Presets, complete recipe builder, strict validator, serialiser. | | `living-type-mask.ts` | Font readiness, content-addressed mask cache key, Canvas 2D rasteriser. | | `living-type.recipe.schema.json` | JSON Schema 2020-12 for recipes. | | `living-type.recipe.example.json` | Valid recipe fixture. | | `README.md` | This file. | | `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` | Dependency and fingerprint provenance. | | `PAPER_SHADERS_LICENSE.txt` / `PAPER_SHADERS_NOTICE.txt` | Apache-2.0 license and required notice. | | `UNBOUNDED_OFL.txt` | Font license and copyright. | Runtime dependency installed by the registry: - `@paper-design/shaders-react@0.0.82` (Apache-2.0) The font is **not** an npm dependency and is **not** fetched from a CDN. An ASCII subset of Unbounded Variable 5.3.0 is embedded as a WOFF2 data URI in `living-type-font.css`. The shadcn registry transports text files, not binary assets, so this keeps the install to one item while preserving the font licence and exact provenance. No Nullworx route, global CSS, `next/font`, `@/lib` alias, lab UI or composition editor is required. The only aliases in sample imports are the consumer's own component path. ## Install ```sh npx shadcn@4.23.0 add /r/living-type-01.json --yes ``` For the local G5-A review build the registry is served at `http://127.0.0.1:3102/r/living-type-01.json`. There is no public registry URL in this task. The CLI installs the source, docs, licences and the one runtime dependency. The item does not inject global CSS, Tailwind, theme tokens or a reset. When the consumer's `components.json` uses a `src/` directory, shadcn resolves the same target under `src/components/living-type-01/`; both layouts are tested. **Installer requirement:** use `shadcn@4.23.0` or newer. shadcn `3.0.0` parses every installed file as TSX, which strips comments and can corrupt string literals and Markdown (observed in G5-A: `join(" ")` became `join("")`). `4.23.0` preserved all 12 files byte-for-byte in both consumers. ## Use ```tsx "use client"; import { LivingType } from "@/components/living-type-01/living-type"; export function Wordmark() { return ( ); } ``` If your project does not use the `@/` alias, import the folder relatively: ```tsx import { LivingType } from "./components/living-type-01/living-type"; ``` The component fills its parent's width and owns its aspect ratio (from the recipe). Wrap it in a width-constrained element to size it: ```tsx
``` ### Props | Prop | Type | Default | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `recipe` | `LivingTypeRecipe` | — | Complete recipe. Takes precedence over convenience props. | | `text` | `string` | `"NULLWORX"` | Up to 24 ASCII characters; see limits. | | `preset` | `"night-bloom" \| "kiln" \| "low-tide"` | `"night-bloom"` | Art direction defaults. | | `paused` | `boolean` | recipe value | Freezes the current shader frame. | | `reducedMotion` | `"auto" \| "force"` | `"auto"` | `auto` follows the OS; `force` is static. | | `weight` | `200–900`, step 100 | preset value | Self-hosted Unbounded Variable. | | `fit` | `0.55–0.94` | preset value | Fraction of frame width used by the ink. | | `tracking` | `-0.04–0.14` em | preset value | Applied in the canvas mask. | | `aspect` | `2–5` | preset value | Frame width / height. | | `colors` | `[hex, hex, hex, hex]` | preset value | Four `#RGB`/`#RRGGBB` shader colours. | | `material` | partial material params | preset value | `speed`, `distortion`, `swirl`, `grainMixer`, `grainOverlay`, `scale`, `rotation`. | | `className` / `style` | React values | — | Scoped wrapper styling. `aspect-ratio` is enforced from the recipe. | | `onRendererStateChange` | callback | — | Observe `loading`, `shader`, `static-fallback`, `context-lost`, `mask-error`, `mask-unsupported`, `shader-error`. | When `recipe` is present, its configuration wins. `paused` and `reducedMotion` remain explicit runtime overrides. ### Presets | Preset | Treatment | | --- | --- | | **Night Bloom** | Near-black field, ultraviolet/apricot/cyan currents, tight 700 display weight, soft bloom, restless movement. | | **Kiln** | Warm paper field, fired earth palette, heavy 800 weight, low distortion and coarse grain. | | **Low Tide** | Sea-glass paper field, cold teal/cobalt palette, light 400 weight, wide tracking and lateral drift. | The presets differ in weight, tracking, frame ratio, material parameters, grain and palette — not only hue. ## Recipes A recipe stores **configuration**, not a timeline. It contains no time value. Re-importing a recipe restores the same supported settings and, when mounted paused, the same initial static frame under the same browser, font and viewport. Animated output is live and is **not** a frame-perfect replay. ```ts import { DEFAULT_LIVING_TYPE_RECIPE, createLivingTypeRecipe, parseLivingTypeRecipe, stringifyLivingTypeRecipe, updateLivingTypeRecipe, } from "@/components/living-type-01/living-type-recipe"; const recipe = createLivingTypeRecipe({ text: "ACME", preset: "kiln", paused: true, reducedMotion: "auto", }); const json = stringifyLivingTypeRecipe(recipe); // includes a trailing newline const loaded = parseLivingTypeRecipe(json); if (!loaded.ok) { console.error(loaded.issues); } else { // } ``` Strict validation rejects unknown fields, unsupported schema/effect/font versions, out-of-range values, non-hex colours and unsupported characters. The validator rebuilds a canonical object; it never spreads arbitrary JSON into CSS. ### Limits - Single line, Latin only: `A–Z`, `a–z`, `0–9`, space, `.`, `&`, `'`, `!`, `?`, `+`, `-`, `/`. Maximum 24 characters. No Unicode, SVG, HTML, CSS or JS. - The font family and ASCII subset are pinned. Customer-supplied font families are not supported in this build, so cross-machine metric drift is limited to browser Canvas rasterisation differences. - Recipes restore configuration and paused stills, not deterministic animation frames. - WebGL2 is required for the Paper material. Without it, the component displays real static type and a status label; it does not fake the shader. - CSS `mask-image` alpha support is required. If the feature test fails, the component shows the same real static fallback instead of an unmasked shader rectangle. ## Accessibility - The readable wordmark is a visually hidden DOM text node, so assistive technology receives the actual word once. - The canvas/mask/fallback visual layers are `aria-hidden`. - Loading and fallback states use `role="status"`; recipe rejection uses `role="alert"`. - `reducedMotion="auto"` follows `prefers-reduced-motion`. When reduced, the Paper loop is set to speed 0 and stops requesting animation frames. - A lost WebGL context shows a static fallback and an accessible retry button. - No keyboard interaction is required to use the effect. The only focusable control is the recovery button in an error state. ## Browser and runtime requirements Tested on the G5-A evidence run: - Chromium (system Chrome 156, hardware ANGLE/GL) - Firefox (Playwright build) - WebKit (Playwright WebKitGTK build) - React 19.1.10, Next.js 15.5.28 and Vite + React 19 - WebGL2, Canvas 2D, CSS `mask-image` with `mask-mode: alpha`, `ResizeObserver` - Node 20+ for the consumer build (evidence used Node 24.20.0) The Paper package peer range is React 18/19; only React 19 was verified here. CSS mask alpha is required for the effect. Check your target browser's support before shipping; the fallback is not the shader. ## Font Unbounded Variable 5.3.0, ASCII subset (U+0020–007E, variable weight 200–900), is embedded in `living-type-font.css` as a WOFF2 data URI. The component imports that CSS. No external font request is made and there is no font package dependency. The full OFL licence is in `UNBOUNDED_OFL.txt`; the original and subset SHA-256 hashes are recorded in the CSS header and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. The subset was produced with fontTools `pyftsubset` from the official Fontsource latin variable build. The upstream licence declares no reserved font name; the family name is used unmodified. ## Performance notes - Paper is dynamically imported after the component is on screen; the shader is not part of the first route chunk. - The shader canvas is bounded with `minPixelRatio={1}` and `maxPixelCount={1_500_000}`. - Mask rasters are capped at 4096 px wide and 2× effective DPR, debounced 90 ms, and serialised through one reusable canvas per component. Rapid edits abort stale tasks and hide the mask until the current key is ready. - Object URLs are revoked when a mask is replaced or the component unmounts. ## License Paper Shaders is Apache-2.0; required NOTICE included. Unbounded is OFL-1.1. Nullworx-authored source has **no assigned project license** in this experimental build and is provided for owner review/local verification only. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and the license files.

# Third-party notices — NULLWORX / Living Type 01

This item is **EXPERIMENTAL / OWNER_REVIEW**. It is not published to a public
registry and no package is published to npm.

## Paper Shaders — Apache-2.0

- Installed package: `@paper-design/shaders-react@0.0.82`
- Transitive package: `@paper-design/shaders@0.0.82`
- Copyright 2026 Paper
- Upstream: <https://github.com/paper-design/shaders>
- License: [PAPER_SHADERS_LICENSE.txt](./PAPER_SHADERS_LICENSE.txt)
- Required notice: [PAPER_SHADERS_NOTICE.txt](./PAPER_SHADERS_NOTICE.txt)

The NOTICE text, verbatim:

> Paper Shaders
> Copyright 2026 Paper
>
> Powered by Paper Shaders:
> https://shaders.paper.design

No Paper Shaders source is vendored, modified or reimplemented. Living Type 01
imports the published React `MeshGradient` component and sets documented props.
The image in the wordmark is produced by the upstream shader; the type mask is
built by this item with Canvas 2D and applied with CSS masking.

## Unbounded Variable — SIL Open Font License 1.1

- Face: Unbounded Variable, weight 200–900, ASCII subset (U+0020–007E)
- Copyright 2022 The Unbounded Project Authors
  (<https://github.com/googlefonts/unbounded>)
- License: [UNBOUNDED_OFL.txt](./UNBOUNDED_OFL.txt)
- Source package: `@fontsource-variable/unbounded@5.3.0`
- Upstream packaging: <https://fontsource.org/fonts/unbounded>
- Source WOFF2 SHA-256:
  `22f9b928aa3928a896340422b54d690fbb5875c30eae4c106f029c61f2289fd6`
- Embedded subset SHA-256:
  `3e99d2422c4a5c962cbd13889295e0d7d5273c844aeff1a2b35f9c54c4721d2b`
- Subset tool: fontTools `pyftsubset` (`--unicodes=U+0020-007E`,
  `--layout-features='*'`, `--flavor=woff2`)

The font is self-hosted inside the installed component as a base64 WOFF2 data
URI in `living-type-font.css`; no font CDN and no font npm dependency are used.
The shadcn registry transports text files, so embedding is the documented,
reproducible asset transport. The OFL permits bundling and redistribution of the
font with software; the upstream licence declares no reserved font name and the
family name is not modified by this item.

## Nullworx-authored source

The Living Type component, recipe contract, schema, documentation and presets
were authored for Nullworx G5-A. The Nullworx repository has **no assigned
project license**. This experimental item is provided for owner review and local
consumer verification only; it does not grant a redistribution or commercial
license for Nullworx-authored source. Third-party terms above apply regardless.

## Consumer runtime

The consumer supplies React and its framework (Next.js or Vite). Those packages
retain their own licenses. Living Type 01 does not bundle or license them.
